description.value: MeetRice Noodle is a restaurant on Alexandra Road in Richmond, BC — a street well-known as one of Metro Vancouver's most concentrated strips of Asian dining. The restaurant's name suggests a focus on rice noodle dishes, placing it within Richmond's vibrant Cantonese and pan-Asian food scene. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's flat, bikeable streets will find this area rich with food options.
